'''Zyyskel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] criminal living during the [[Galactic War]]. Imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Zyyskel was forcibly drafted into the [[Project Noble Focus]], which forced alien inmates of different species to compete against each other to learn their strengths and weaknesses. However, around [[3641 BBY]] a [[Invasion of Belsavis|riot]] broke out and many of the prisoners involved in the project got free. In particular, Zyyskel and his fellow Gand went insane, hunting down those responsible for their torture. They captured many colleagues of Doctor [[Everis]], on whose behest a Republic citizen freed the prisoners and killed the Gand, including Zyyskel.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zyyskel appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Boss during the heroic mission "A Lesson is Learned".
